allow_fallbacks.description: Whether to allow fallback providers if the preferred provider is unavailable.

require_parameters.description: Whether to require that the provider supports all specified parameters.

order.description: An ordered list of provider names to use when selecting a provider for this model.

only.description: A list of provider names to restrict selection to when selecting a provider for this model.

ignore.description: A list of provider names to ignore when selecting a provider for this model.

quantizations.description: Specifies the quantizations to allow when selecting providers for this model.

description: Options for selecting the upstream provider of this model.
